failures.title: Session State Serialization Boundary Broken
failures.description: Agents produce runtime ContextFrame state but cannot serialize to persistence layer. Checkpoint system expects different format.

failures.title: Graph Authority Does Not Drive Runtime Decisions
failures.description: Pattern graph (pattern_graph.py) stores relationships but OODA loop makes decisions independently. Graph not queried during execution.
failures.missing_layer: Query interface from execution to graph
evidence: Mermaid diagrams show graph influence but code has none

failures.title: Tool Results Not Persisted to State Model
failures.description: Copilot tools (GitHub MCP server) return results but no mechanism to update backend state/graph with results.
evidence: Tool calls return JSON but no persistence contract
Backend has no listener for tool completion events
State only updated if agent manually calls update()
failures.impact: Tool insights cannot be leveraged by autonomous loops

failures.title: CI/CD Artifacts Not Flowing to RAG/Memory
failures.description: CI runs, produces artifacts (test results, coverage, logs) but no automated ingestion to knowledge store.
evidence: .github/workflows/ produce artifacts but no ingestion target
No event-driven trigger for knowledge updates
failures.impact: Agents cannot learn from CI data

conclusion.pattern: Boundaries exist but no integration layer crosses them
conclusion.recommendation: Build explicit adapters at each system boundary
